display.purpose: Page titles only (Home, space, meeting, Settings); the wordmark at 17px.

numeral.purpose: Day-of-month figure in the Now card date block.

headline.purpose: Document section headings with a faint hanging '#'.

title.purpose: Sub-headings in notes and summaries; settings group titles.

body-doc.purpose: Reading text in notes, summaries, agenda, briefs.

label.purpose: Group headings, speaker labels, subtitles, descriptions.

mono.purpose: Times, durations, elapsed timer, keycaps, version.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: Toasts and the live dock (the dock adds a contact shadow).

shadows.name: float-contact
shadows.purpose: Second layer under the live dock only.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Color, border, and opacity transitions on controls.

motion.name: page-in
motion.purpose: Each page settles into place on open.

motion.name: live-pulse
motion.purpose: Live dots on the sidebar, feed tiles, and meeting meta.

motion.name: level
motion.value: 0.9s ease-in-out infinite; bar height 4px to 14px, 140ms stagger

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce disables live-pulse, level, page-in

themes.mechanism: Light by default; follows prefers-color-scheme; :root[data-theme=light|dark] forces a theme. Every *-dark color token is the dark half of a pair defined in src/styles/theme.css.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Inverted ink button for the one main action (Start meeting, toast actions).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: var(--font-sans); display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; height:32px; padding:0 14px; font-size:14px; font-weight:500; color:var(--color-background); background:var(--color-text); border:1px solid var(--color-text); border-radius:12px; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 150ms, border-color 150ms, opacity 150ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-text) 85%, transparent); border-color:color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-text) 85%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-accent) 70%, transparent); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity:.4; cursor:not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button

components.name: Meeting Feed Row

components.css: .ds-row { font-family: var(--font-sans); width:100%; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:14px; padding:10px 12px; border:0; border-radius:16px; background:transparent; text-align:start; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 150ms; } .ds-row:hover { background:var(--color-surface); } .ds-row:focus-visible { outline:2px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-accent) 70%, transparent); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-tile { width:36px; height:36px; flex-shrink:0; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; border:1px solid var(--color-line); border-radius:12px; background:var(--color-surface); color:var(--color-text-faint); } .ds-row-text { flex:1; min-width:0; display:flex; flex-direction:column; } .ds-row-title { font-size:14.5px; line-height:20px; color:var(--color-text); } .ds-row-sub { font-size:13px; line-height:20px; color:var(--color-text-faint); } .ds-row-time { font-family:var(--font-mono); font-size:11.5px; color:var(--color-text-faint); font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }

} .ds-dock-level i:nth-child(4) { animation-delay:420ms; } @keyframes ds-level { 0%,100% { height:4px; } 50% { height:14px; } } .ds-dock-text { display:flex; flex-direction:column; padding:0 8px; } .ds-dock-text span { font-size:13px; narrative.overview:
A meeting is a document, not a record. Meet Assist sets every meeting as a centered page with a serif title, read top to bottom: agenda, nudges, notes, and the transcript last. The shell around it is a near-silent zinc ground: a slightly tinted sidebar, a white (or near-black) canvas, hairlines drawn in text-alpha rather than gray, and almost nothing raised off the page. It is a reading surface between calls, not a dashboard.

Density is calm and editorial. One 720px column, generous 40px breaks between document sections, and 14px UI type with 15px reading type. Color is nearly absent: the one blue accent marks only what is alive or yours (a running meeting, focus, selection, your lines in the transcript, an undismissed nudge). Actions are carried by an inverted neutral button, so the accent never has to compete with a call to action.

The live meeting is the one thing allowed to float. The live dock, a pill at the foot of the canvas with a pulsing level meter, timer, pause, and end, sits above every page while a meeting runs; it is the system's signature and its only persistent elevated object.
keyCharacteristics: Zinc neutrals in matched light and dark pairs; both themes are first-class and follow the OS unless forced.
One blue accent, reserved for live state, focus, selection, and "you".
Three voices of type: Newsreader for page titles, DM Sans for everything read or clicked, JetBrains Mono for times, durations, and keys.
Flat by default; depth comes from tonal steps (canvas, sidebar, surface, surface-hover) and alpha hairlines.
Rounded but not soft: 12px controls, 16px containers, full pills for chips, meta, and the dock.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Blue means alive, focused, selected, or yours. If an element is none of those, it is neutral; ordinary actions use the inverted ink button, not the accent.

rules.name: The Alpha Hairline Rule
rules.body: Borders are ink at low alpha (8% / 15% light, 8% / 14% dark), never a fixed gray, so they sit correctly on every tonal step.

rules.name: The Paired Token Rule
rules.body: A themed color is added as a `--light-color-*` / `--dark-color-*` pair in `src/styles/theme.css` and wired through all three active blocks; no color is written as a literal in components.

rules.name: The Serif Is a Title Rule
rules.body: Newsreader appears only as a page title, the day numeral, and the wordmark. Never in body, buttons, or section headings.

rules.name: The Numbers Line Up Rule
rules.body: Every time, duration, count, and shortcut is mono or carries `tabular-nums`.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Labels and section names are sentence case at normal tracking; the system has no uppercase tracked eyebrows.

rules.name: The One Column Rule
rules.body: Content lives in the centered 720px column. No multi-column dashboards, no settings-panel grids in the main pane.

rules.name: The Only-Floaters-Cast Rule
rules.body: A shadow means "this is above the page". If it scrolls with the document, it is flat.

dos: Do reserve the accent for live state, focus, selection, "you", and undismissed nudges.
Do use the inverted ink button for the one main action on a surface.
Do set page titles in Newsreader 32px and everything else in DM Sans; put times and keys in JetBrains Mono with tabular figures.
Do keep content in the centered 720px column with 40px between document sections and 128px bottom padding under the dock.
Do draw borders with the alpha hairline tokens and separate layers with tonal steps before reaching for a shadow.
Do add new colors as light/dark pairs in `src/styles/theme.css` and use them through the Tailwind token names.
Do ease entrances with `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)` and turn the live pulse, level meter, and page-in off under reduced motion.
donts: Don't use the accent as a button fill or for decoration; a blue that does not mean "alive or yours" dilutes the signal.
Don't put shadows on in-page cards; only the dock, toasts, tooltips, and menus float.
Don't use the serif for body, buttons, or section headings.
Don't add uppercase tracked eyebrows or kickers above titles; headings are sentence case.
Don't write color literals in components; the old Handy pink (#FAA2CA) is not part of this system.
Don't arrange the main pane as grouped boxes in a narrow settings column; meetings and spaces are documents.
